7959bf.title: WP recon inventory: dkv.smkn1-pkp.sch.id
7959bf.content:
## WordPress fingerprint — dkv.smkn1-pkp.sch.id

**Core**: WordPress 6.9.10
Evidence: `<meta name="generator" content="WordPress 6.9.10">`; RSS `<generator>https://wordpress.org/?v=6.9.10</generator>`; `wp-includes/js/wp-util.min.js?ver=6.9.10`; wp-login `?ver=6.9.10`.

**Server/Tech**: LiteSpeed (origin). WAF/bot-challenge edge observed under load — `Server: openresty/1.31.1.1`, JS challenge page "One moment, please..." (5s auto-reload), headers `cf-edge-cache`, `CDN-Cache-Control`, `x-speedycache-source: Server`. wafw00f generic = none. Vendor unconfirmed.

**Active theme**: Astra 4.14.1 (style.css + readme.txt). Premium addon Astra Pro / Astra Addon (slug `astra-addon`) **3.9.2** (via `wp-content/uploads/astra-addon/*?ver=3.9.2`; dir `astra-addon/astra-addon.php` guarded/500). REST CPT `astra-advanced-hook` confirms active.

**Attack surface**:
- xmlrpc.php → 403 Forbidden (GET + system.listMethods POST blocked server-side)
- wp-json/ REST enabled. Custom CPTs: e-floating-buttons, elementor_library, spectra-popup, astra-advanced-hook
- /wp-json/wp/v2/users?per_page=100 → 1 user: id 1, slug `suh3ng`, name `suh3ng`, /author/suh3ng/

- wp-content/debug.log 404; wp-config.php.{bak,~,save} 403; .git/HEAD 403

**CVE candidate areas (verify next phase)**: Elementor Pro 3.7.5 (2021, severely outdated vs free 4.3.5); Astra Pro addon 3.9.2 (outdated); PageLayer 2.2.2; LoginPress 6.2.5; WPForms Lite 2.0.2.2; SureMail 2.0.3; GoSMTP 1.2.4; The Post Grid 7.9.7; Spectra Legacy 2.20.5.
